title: Cardy crossing probabilities for Poisson–Voronoi percolation
exact_target: For critical planar Poisson–Voronoi percolation and every bounded Jordan quadrilateral, do annealed crossing probabilities converge at vanishing mesh to $integral_0^x$ $[u(1-u)]^{-2/3}du$ divided by $integral_0^1$ $[u(1-u)]^{-2/3}du$, where x is the conformal cross ratio of the marked sides?
